;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2017 Temple Mount shooting]]
**Two [[Druze in Israel|Druze]] Israeli police officers are killed in an attack at [[Temple Mount]] in [[Jerusalem]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-40604452 (BBC)]
*[[Insurgency in Egypt (2013–present)]]
**Gunmen shoot dead five [[Law enforcement in Egypt|police officers]] near [[Giza]]. [https://web.archive.org/web/20170714113857/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/egypts-state-run-media-attack-kills-police-giza-48631936 (ABC News)]
**[[2017 Hurghada attack]]
***Two female tourists are killed and four others are wounded in a mass stabbing attack at a hotel in [[Hurghada]], [[Red Sea Governorate]]. The attacker is detained. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-40611921 (BBC)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[Marco Polo condo fire]]
**At least three people are killed and two hospitalized, one in serious condition, from a fire in a  condominium tower in the [[United States|U.S.]] city of [[Honolulu]], [[Hawaii]]. An unknown number of residents are reportedly still trapped in their apartments. [http://www.foxnews.com/us/2017/07/15/honolulu-fire-at-least-3-dead-in-high-rise-fears-that-residents-are-trapped.html (AP via Fox News)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-hawaii-fire-idUSKBN1A0025?il=0 (Reuters)]
*Ten people are killed after a bus and a truck collided head-on in [[Probolinggo]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://jateng.tribunnews.com/2017/07/14/kecelakaan-maut-truk-tabrak-bus-di-pantura-probolinggo-10-orang-tewas (Tribunjateng.com (in Indonesian)] 

;Law and crime
*[[First presidency of Donald Trump|Presidency of Donald Trump]]
**The [[White House]] releases unredacted [[email]]s of people concerned about the [[Presidential Advisory Commission on Election Integrity]]. Sensitive information revealed in the emails prompts immediate backlash and privacy concerns. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/wonk/wp/2017/07/14/white-house-releases-sensitive-personal-information-of-voters-worried-about-their-sensitive-personal-information/ (''The Washington Post'')] [http://nymag.com/selectall/2017/07/funny-emails-sent-to-kobachs-election-integrity-commission.html (''The New York magazine'')]
*Aftermath of the [[Mamasapano clash]]
**Former [[President of the Philippines]] [[Benigno Aquino III|Benigno "Noynoy" Aquino III]] is [[Indictment|indicted]] (among others) by the [[Ombudsman of the Philippines|Office of the Ombudsman]] for his failure in handling the [[Mamasapano clash|2015 Mamasapano clash]], which resulted in the deaths of 44 members of the [[Special Action Force|Special Action Forces]] of the [[Philippine National Police]]. Aquino's legal team has vowed to appeal for a motion for reconsideration; as well as the group Volunteers Against Crime and Corruption (representing the victims' families), against what they call a "weak case" (citing Aquino's charges of "graft" & "usurpation of authority", instead of "reckless imprudence resulting in multiple homicide") [http://www.rappler.com/nation/175603-noynoy-aquino-indicted-graft-mamasapano-ombudsman (Rappler)] [https://web.archive.org/web/20170717061748/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/philippines-leader-faces-charges-role-clash-48631698 (ABC News.go)]

*[[Corruption in Peru]], [[Operation Car Wash]]
**A court of [[Lima]] orders 18 months of pre-trial imprisonment for former president [[Ollanta Humala]] and his wife [[Nadine Heredia]] for alleged [[money laundering]]. Both have turned themselves in. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-40605823 (BBC)]

*[[Executive Order 13780]], ''[[Hawaii v. Trump]]''
**The [[First presidency of Donald Trump|Trump Administration]] asks the [[Supreme Court of the United States|U.S. Supreme Court]] to stop implementation of yesterday's ruling by [[United States District Court for the District of Hawaii|Hawaii District Judge]] [[Derrick Watson]] that expanded the [[United States Department of State|State Department's]] definition of "close family" used to implement the Supreme Court's June  order that permits admission to the U.S. of  those with a bona fide relationship.  [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-immigration-idUSKBN19Z1R7?il=0 (Reuters)] [http://live.reuters.com/Event/Live_US_Politics/989297085 (U.S. State Department via Reuters)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Politics of Australia]]
**Deputy Leader of the [[Australian Greens]] [[Scott Ludlam]] resigns as a [[Australian Senate|Senator]] after discovering that he holds [[dual citizenship]] with [[New Zealand]], making him electorally ineligible under [[Section 44 of the Constitution of Australia]]. [http://www.abc.net.au/news/2017-07-14/senator-scott-ludlam-resign-constitution-dual-citizenship/8708606 (ABC.net)]
*[[Politics of Hong Kong]]
**Four lawmakers are removed from the [[Hong Kong]] [[Legislative Council of Hong Kong|legislature]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2017/07/14/world/asia/hong-kong-court-pro-democracy-lawmakers.html (''The New York Times'')]
